stem.text: Nucleus P has 144 neutrons and 93 protons. Nucleus P is unstable and undergoes $\alpha$-decay to form nucleus Q. Nucleus Q then undergoes $\beta^{-}$ decay to form nucleus R.
Nucleus P is represented by point P on the graph.

stem.alt: Graph of number of neutrons (140 to 146) against proton number (90 to 96), with points labelled P, A, B, C and D.

stem.text: Which point on the graph represents nucleus R?
